# Jeremiah 32 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 32:4 (overlap: 3%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | And-Jeremiah spoke-of the-purchase-of the-field in-Anathoth, as-a-sign that houses and-fields and-vineyards would-again-be-bought in-this-land. |
| LOGOS | Jeremiah described the purchase of the field at Anathoth as a sign that houses, fields, and vineyards would once again be bought in this land. |
| PNEUMA | Jeremiah went on to describe buying the field at Anathoth — an act of defiant hope, a sign that life would go on, that property would again be bought and sold in this devastated land. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
